cardOverview.overviewText: SBI Signature Corporate is a business credit card designed for corporate expense management, offering controlled employee spending, wider acceptance, and convenient payment tracking.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Air accidental death : If the ticket is purchased on the corporate card, sum assured is Rs. 1 Cr.|Lost card liability : For misuse of the lost card- 7 days prior notification and 7 days post notification, sum assured is upto Rs. 3 lakhs and For fraud add-on cover against Counterfeit (including Phishing & Vishing), Skimming and Online Frauds, sum assured is upto Rs. 2 lakhs.|Travel insurance : For baggage loss,sum assured is up to Rs. 75,000, For baggage delay, sum assured is up to Rs. 7,500, For loss of passport (only international), sum assured is up to Rs. 12,500 and For flight delay, sum assured is up to Rs. 15,000.
